narrative.overview: LogLens is an offline-first, browser-native log forensics and distributed tracing console. It pairs extreme information density (Gantt waterfall timelines, Swiss-aligned execution trees, flamegraphs, dependency topologies) with Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) craft: native San Francisco typography, translucent frosted backdrops, double-layer sheet depth, and grouped card layouts. The design strictly serves developer velocity: zero telemetry or tracking, zero cloud friction, zero dependencies, and zero decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Extreme Information Density: Compact 50px header, collapsible 322px sidebar, Swiss 3-zone execution tree grid, and bounded viewport flex layouts that never waste vertical canvas space.

Apple HIG Refinement: Native San Francisco font stack (-apple-system, SF Pro, SF Mono), 26px circular close buttons, macOS sheet modal elevations (backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%)), and spring-animated sliding pills.
Perceptually Calibrated Theming: 6 distinct calibrated themes (Obsidian, Ivory, Aurora, Midnight, Forest, Crimson) built on OKLCH color ramps sharing uniform semantic token interfaces.

Tactile Developer Ergonomics: Seamless keyboard shortcuts (Alt+1..0, direct single-keystroke 1..0 navigation, ⌘K / Ctrl+K Spotlight, J/K tree traversal), instant zero-network file processing, and zero layout shift.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: Saturated semantic accents (Amber, Blue, Green, Red) must never exceed 10% of any viewport surface area. They carry diagnostic state, not decorative wallpaper.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text, timestamps, and log payload strings must maintain ≥4.5:1 contrast against their card background across all 6 themes.

rules.name: The Monospace Data Rule
rules.body: Any value originating from a log file, duration calculation, capture token, or LQL query expression must render in --mono to preserve strict tabular column alignment.

rules.name: The Native System Zero-Shift Rule
rules.body: All font stacks prioritize native system fonts (-apple-system, SF Pro, SF Mono). Web fonts must never be downloaded at runtime, guaranteeing zero layout shift (CLS = 0) and zero offline font failures.

rules.name: The Bounded Viewport Rule
rules.body: Canvas containers must define min-height: 0 and flex: 1 with strict overflow isolation. Outer parent pages must never scroll vertically when a timeline, tree, or table is active.

rules.name: The Swiss Ledger Alignment Rule
rules.body: Numbers, durations, sparkbars, and timestamps in telemetry columns must occupy fixed-width sub-columns with right alignment, ensuring clean vertical scanning like a Swiss financial ledger.

rules.name: The Frosted Backdrop Rule
rules.body: All modal backdrops and floating toolbars must pair translucent backgrounds (rgba(..., 0.8)) with backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%) to maintain background context without visual clutter.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: All in-canvas data surfaces (tables, Gantt tracks, tree nodes) are completely flat at rest with 1px hairline borders. Drop shadows appear solely as responses to elevation states.

rules.name: The Hierarchy-Driven Radius Rule
rules.body: Corner radius scales strictly with container area: 4px for tags, 6px for controls, 14px for grouped cards/modals. Controls inside cards must never have a larger corner radius than their parent card.

dos: Do maintain strict single-file HTML architecture (loglens.html) with zero runtime npm or CDN dependencies.
Do preserve full vertical real estate for timeline and execution tree views by limiting metric summary cards exclusively to the dedicated Stats dashboard.
Do lock Zone 1 of the Execution Tree to a 420px spine anchor across all nesting depths to prevent payload preview jitter.
Do wrap all interactive dialogs and HUD cards with macOS frosted blurs (backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%)) and double-layer shadows.
Do use flex-shrink: 0 on structural metric bars (#stats-bar, #res-summary-cards) to prevent layout squashing inside scrollable containers.
Do maintain strict keyboard navigation parity (Alt+1..0, direct 1..0 navigation, ⌘K / Ctrl+K, Escape to close drawers/modals, J/K tree traversal).
Do enforce white-space: nowrap on tree row payload previews to prevent multi-line word wrap staircases.
donts: Don't add bulky decorative hero cards above the timeline canvas or execution tree.
Don't use generic fluid clamp scales that distort dashboard information density.
Don't import external CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap), icon libraries (FontAwesome, Lucide), or runtime web fonts; rely strictly on vanilla CSS and native San Francisco stacks.
Don't display redundant blue INFO badges on healthy execution tree rows.
Don't allow saturated semantic accents to exceed 10% of any viewport surface area.
Don't use side-stripe borders or gradient text for emphasis.
